sources.license: Traced facts from a public TJPA report (the PDF is not redistributed). Trackwork: Public domain: 'a work of the United States government as defined in 17 U.S.C. § 101 ... available for unrestricted public use' (service copyright text).
sources.notes: Alignment as drawn in BAM (data/lines/the-portal.geojson at 9600699). Approximate alignment traced from TJPA's map of the current (2026) design: 1.76 miles from the tunnel's west end to the east end of the train box, which includes the below-grade approach at the west end (U-wall and tunnel stub box), so it is longer than TJPA's '1.3-mile tunnel'; plus 0.39 miles of trackwork on existing tracks to 16th Street (2.15 miles in all; TJPA: 'total project length is 2.2 miles'). Georeferenced on 35 street intersections (DataSF centrelines), RMS 1.18 m; the map draws the line about 37 m wide, so the centreline is good to several metres. Stations are the centres of the station shapes in the map.

sources.title: Valley Link Board packet (June 10, 2026), Figure 4, and Draft SEIR (2024) figures
sources.license: Traced facts from public documents of the Tri-Valley-San Joaquin Valley Regional Rail Authority (PDFs not redistributed). Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps. Station checks: BART GTFS (bart.gov developer terms); Caltrans California Transit Stops (public, no license stated).
sources.notes: Alignment as drawn in BAM (data/lines/valley-link.geojson at 9600699). Approximate alignment traced from the Authority's figures: 11.4 miles as drawn (the Authority: 'approximately 11 miles'). Figure 4 of the June 2026 report gives the current Phase 1A route from First Street to Vasco Road; the I-580 median and the stations come from the 2024 Draft SEIR, whose median alignment the 2026 report keeps. The figures are fitted to OpenStreetMap with RMS 1.3-3.0 m, and the lines are drawn tens of metres wide, so the centreline is good to about 10-20 m, not to the track. The 82-m join from the Dublin/Pleasanton platform into the median is not drawn in the figures and is a straight line. Phase 1B (Southfront Road to Mountain House, unfunded) is not drawn.
